warning.titleHighlight: (L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) I6)
paragraphs: The L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) rebuild.
Because the Freelander 2.0 Di / Td4 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Freelander 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established L-Series (early Di) or BMW M47D20 (later Td4) specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
